description: The Play School Facilitator cum Caregiver is responsible for providing safe, nurturing, and developmentally appropriate care to infants and toddlers (26 years) in daycare centres, and community childcare settings, with a focus on holistic early childhood development. The role involves ensuring childrens health, hygiene, nutrition, and safety while creating a responsive and emotionally secure environment that promotes social, physical, and cognitive growth through play-based and activity-oriented engagement. Drawing from approaches such as the Montessori Method, the caregiver facilitates hands-on, self-directed learning experiences suited to young childrens developmental needs. This role is designed to formalise and strengthen existing caregiving practices, enhancing the quality of early childcare services, and distinctly focuses on caregiving and developmental support
